localFacts.fact: Ajuntament de Barcelona: a permit is needed to photograph or film on the public street if you use a tripod or another special element; the basic permit allows at most one tripod, max. 10 people, and no vehicles or drones. A dolly is a special element to clear with the Barcelona Film Commission. General information, not legal advice.
Madrid: filming permits on public streets, parks and gardens are granted by the Negociado de Autorizaciones de Rodaje; the Madrid Film Office advises productions.

Iberia allows a cabin bag of up to 10 kg and max. 56 x 40 x 25 cm; the folding clamp dollies (K&F 38,5 cm, SmallRig 43 cm, NEEWER 45 cm folded) fit that length, the Manfrotto 114 (64,7 cm closed) does not.
Local terms: dolly para trípode / base con ruedas, ruedas con freno, pies de goma vs. puntas (pinchos), travelling, vía (raíl) de dolly.

localPainPoints.pain: On parquet or tiles the recording picks up the wheels' jumps; only perfectly smooth floors work.
localPainPoints.fix: Slow moves on hard, level floors with rubber wheels of 3 in or more; for steady moves add track or a slider (English post).

quotes.text: En parqué o baldosas la grabación registrará los saltos que den las ruedas al deslizarse por ese tipo de suelos.

localPainPoints.pain: Brakes that lock on their own and ruin the job.
localPainPoints.fix: Before recording, release and check every wheel lock and push the dolly an inch so the casters trail in line (English post); lock all wheels only when the camera is static.

quotes.text: Dos de las ruedas se quedaban frenadas cuando querían y no se pudo hacer bien el trabajo
